# Cerul Robotics

> Open-source CLI that labels robot episodes with your own model endpoints: timed subtasks, events, hand-object interactions and state changes, local human-hand tracking on CPU, review videos, and LeRobot v3.1 subtask writeback. One binary for macOS Apple Silicon and Linux x86_64, Apache-2.0, no account. The hosted API is not open yet.

Labels are generated and not human-verified. It tracks human hands, not robot grippers, and does not estimate depth or calibrated 3D pose.

## Pages

- [Home](https://robotics.cerul.ai/): what it does, install, a real labeled episode
- [Showcase](https://robotics.cerul.ai/showcase): real output with its annotations.json, summary.md and review video
- [Docs](https://robotics.cerul.ai/docs): install, first episode, LeRobot writeback, output files, JSON events, exit codes, configuration
